results.remarks:
Welcome to elevated waterfront living in the highly sought-after Marina Pacifica. This beautifully remodeled 1-bedroom, 1-bath second-floor condo captures serene marina views and abundant natural light through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows. Recently updated with a clean, modern aesthetic, the home features all-new laminate flooring, an extensively remodeled kitchen and bathroom, and thoughtfully selected finishes throughout.

The kitchen is designed with entertaining in mind, highlighted by a built-in wine fridge and seamless flow into the dining area. The wet bar has been reimagined as a functional office nook, ideal for working from home without sacrificing living space. Additional upgrades include recessed lighting, a brand-new A/C system, and an enhanced laundry area with added utility sink.

Storage is exceptional, with California Closets in the hallway, bedroom, and laundry area, plus an added ELFA storage system from The Container Store providing even more flexible organization. A standout feature of the home is the hidden motorized full-size bed tucked beneath the dining area—an innovative space-saving solution that makes hosting guests effortless. The property also includes two side-by-side parking spaces, a rare and valuable convenience within the community.

Step out onto your private balcony to take in peaceful water views, sunset skies, and the calming energy of the marina. Residents of Marina Pacifica enjoy 24-hour guard-gated security and an impressive collection of amenities, including six pools and spas, a fitness center, clubhouse, three scenic lagoons, and direct marina access for paddleboarding and boating. Ideally located near 2nd & PCH, Gelson's Markets, Whole Foods Market, and a wide variety of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. Located in Key 20 at 5203 Marina Pacifica Dr South with professional property video available.

Imagine waking up to soft mornings, light pouring through your windows, the scent of salt air drifting in, and nothing on your agenda but sunshine. This is life at Marina Pacifica.

Beautifully remodeled from top to bottom, this one bedroom, one bathroom residence is where sophisticated coastal living meets modern luxury and every detail has been thoughtfully curated just for you. Come home to resort-style living every single day. Six pools and spas, a fitness center, a clubhouse, tranquil waterways, and 24-hour guard-gated security, all connected by picturesque bridges that make this community feel like its own private world.

This isn’t just a place to live. It’s a place to fall in love with.

Welcome home to Marina Pacifica.

results.remarks: Nestled on the 8th floor of the iconic and beautiful International Tower, this spacious 1260 sqft residence offers City Lights views to the Long Beach Harbor & coastline. Due to the circular construction of the building, the view is beyond 180°. Breathtaking views from every room. In the evening you’ll enjoy jaw-dropping sunsets from your spacious 90-foot wrap-around balcony. The circular shape of the building and its solid concrete construction offer you complete privacy from any neighbors. Wow your friends and family with this spectacular space for entertaining. Spacious open-concept kitchen and living space. Plus exhilarating aerial views of the Long Beach Grand Prix every April and aerial views of Olympic sailing & volleyball events in 2028! Experience the best of vibrant downtown Long Beach living, where restaurants, nightlife, shops and supermarkets are all within walking distance. You’ll rarely need to drive your car, but conveniently, the unit includes 2 dedicated parking spaces. Guest parking is also available. Upon entering the International Tower, guests and residents are welcomed by 24/7 concierge desk service with security and management. A beautifully updated lobby complete with a grand piano, newly remodeled community room, pool & gym, and conference room, all of which have been stylishly refreshed, enhancing the luxury high-rise ambiance. Unit 808 has the versatility of a flex room that opens up to the living room. Creating an expansive, open-concept living area between two primary suites, positioned on opposite sides of the home for optimal privacy. Every room features spectacular panoramic views. Additional highlights include: In-unit washer and dryer, Ceramic tile flooring on the balcony, A modern kitchen with stainless-steel appliances & a view-rich breakfast counter. This residence offers exceptional design, rare views, and coveted privacy. Ready for your vision of making it a spectacular showpiece.

results.remarks:
Situated in the highly sought-after Belmont Heights / 4th Street Corridor, this home places you moments from the best of Long Beach living. Enjoy easy access to Retro Row’s beloved cafés, restaurants, vintage shops, art galleries, and neighborhood favorites. Alamitos Beach, local parks, and the boardwalk are also nearby, making it easy to enjoy the beach lifestyle without giving up city convenience.

Inside, the open and airy layout offers plenty of room to relax and entertain. Modern updates complement the home’s inviting character, including a kitchen with stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, and discreet access to the in-unit washer and dryer.

The comfortable living space features split air conditioning, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, generous storage and closets. A private balcony, accessible from both the living room and primary bedroom, creates a wonderful extension of the home—perfect for morning coffee, an afternoon read, or unwinding under the evening sky.

Additional highlights include one assigned space in the gated building parking area, complete with an EV charger.

With its exceptional location near dining, coffee shops, shopping, public transit, schools, major roads, and the beach, this residence is ideal for first-time buyers, investors, or anyone looking to enjoy the relaxed energy of coastal Long Beach.

This is more than a condo—it is a lifestyle. Imagine brunch at your favorite neighborhood café, browsing Retro Row, spending the afternoon at the beach, and returning home to relax by the fireplace or on your private balcony. Come experience 3600 E. 4th Street for yourself.

results.remarks:
Picture your mornings starting in the custom updated kitchen, coffee in hand at the breakfast bar while the day's plans take shape. When friends come over, you pour drinks at the wet bar and gather everyone around the dining area for a meal that turns into hours of conversation. As the evening cools down, you settle in next to the fireplace with a book or a movie, the kind of moment that makes a house feel like home.

Then there's the balcony. This is where you'll spend your favorite hour of the day, ocean breeze drifting in as the sky turns gold and pink over Long Beach. Whether it's your morning coffee, an evening glass of wine, or just a quiet minute to yourself, this is the space you'll find yourself drawn to again and again.

Life here is easy in all the ways that matter. Laundry day means walking a few steps, not a few blocks, thanks to in-unit washer and dryer that are only 4 months old. The bathrooms were fully remodeled in 2021, the windows were replaced in 2020, and a new hot water tank, AC, and heating system all went in May of 2026, so comfort here is already taken care of. Two assigned garage parking spots mean you're never circling the block, and your HOA dues cover internet, cable, trash, and water, so a few more bills disappear from your to-do list.

This is a place where the everyday feels a little more relaxed. Come see it for yourself.

results.remarks: Welcome to the Carlton Imperial Association where comfort, style, and location come together in this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence offering stunning city and mountain views. This bright and spacious condo features an open, airy layout designed for modern living. Enjoy year-round comfort with air conditioning, complemented by newer vinyl plank flooring, recessed lighting, and elegant crown molding throughout. New windows in both the primary and guest bedrooms enhance energy efficiency and natural light. The expansive living room is filled with natural light and flows seamlessly into the dining area, opening onto an extra-large balcony perfect for relaxing or entertaining while taking in the views. The kitchen is generously sized and well preserved, showcasing gorgeous original cabinetry, with ample space for a breakfast nook or the opportunity to reimagine an open-concept design. Additional highlights include a charming built-in curio cabinet in the living area and abundant hallway storage with custom drawers. The guest bedroom is spacious and sunlit, offering pleasant neighborhood views, while the guest bathroom remains in pristine original condition with timeless tilework. The primary suite features a wall of closets and a private en-suite bath with an updated vanity, creating a comfortable retreat. The home is Ideally located just one block from the Bluffs, offers exceptional walkability to popular restaurants, shops, and coffee houses. The unit also includes two parking spaces, adding convenience to this highly desirable offering. Don’t miss this opportunity to own a stylish and well-maintained home in one of the area’s most sought-after communities.

results.remarks:
The best part about living here isn't just the home. It's everything that happens around it.
Welcome to Above the Palms, 100 Loma Avenue #404. A beautifully remodeled top-floor residence in the coveted Bluff Park neighborhood of Long Beach one block to the ocean, where treetop views, ocean breezes, and natural light create an everyday sense of calm. This 2-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,124 square feet of thoughtfully designed living that feels equal parts modern retreat and coastal escape.
The heart of the home is the open-concept living space, where the designer kitchen flows effortlessly into the dining and living areas, creating a space that's equally suited for quiet mornings or gathering with friends. Crisp white shaker cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom tile accents, recessed lighting, and a sleek fireplace give the home a clean, timeless feel.
The spacious primary suite feels like a boutique hotel, complete with a spa-inspired walk-in shower, dual vanity, large walk-in closet, and convenient in-unit laundry. A generous second bedroom includes lots of natural light and beautifully updated guest bath offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or whatever comes next.

@ 311 Cherry Ave, life moves at an easier rhythm. Tucked inside Bixby Gardens, this light-filled upper-level residence offers a peaceful courtyard setting, mature landscaping, and an expansive balcony for relaxed indoor-outdoor living. Inside, warm wood-toned floors, crisp white walls, pocket doors and generous windows create a bright, comfortable atmosphere. The kitchen adds character with rich wood cabinetry, beautiful counters, tiled backsplash, and ample storage.

Just outside the gate, some of Long Beach’s most loved destinations are close at hand. Retro Row, the Art Theatre, local restaurants, coffee shops, and the 4th Street Farmers Market  are all part of the neighborhood experience, with the ocean nearby for easy coastal escapes. Spend the morning at the market, the afternoon by the water, and the evening enjoying dinner or a movie on 4th Street. Then come home to the lush courtyard and a slower pace that makes this location feel especially inviting. This is what you have been waiting for. Grace on 3rd & Junipero offers parking spaces for approximately $80/month (0.2m or ~4min walk), and Belmont may also have garage spaces available from time to time. Welcome to 730 W 4th Street #308, a bright and inviting 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo offering a comfortable home base in the heart of Long Beach. Thoughtfully laid out across 584 sq. ft., the open living and dining area feels surprisingly spacious, with wood-look flooring, plenty of natural light, and an easy flow into the kitchen. A convenient breakfast bar connects the spaces while providing additional seating and counter space, and the kitchen offers generous cabinetry, granite counters, and everything you need for everyday living.
The bedroom feels like its own retreat, complete with ample closet space, an en-suite bath, and direct access to a private balcony, the perfect spot for morning coffee, fresh air, or winding down at the end of the day. A separate half bath keeps the primary bath private when guests are over, while the in-unit stacked washer and dryer adds the kind of everyday convenience that makes a difference.
The gated community also includes assigned subterranean parking, private storage near the parking space, a community kitchen, and weight room, with HOA dues including water, sewer, and trash.
And then there’s the location. Cesar Chavez Park is directly across the street, The Pike Outlets are approximately one mile away, the beach is about 1.5 miles away, and the 710 Freeway entrance is just minutes from home. Downtown Long Beach dining, entertainment, shopping, waterfront attractions, and everyday conveniences are all close by.
Whether you're looking for an easy Downtown home base or simply want a space that offers comfort, convenience, parking, outdoor space, and access to everything Long Beach has to offer, this one checks a lot of boxes.

results.remarks: Discover the ultimate urban sanctuary in the heart of Downtown Long Beach inside the renowned Newberry Lofts. Step through massive dual pane aluminum sliding doors to enjoy your own secluded outdoor terrace, blending interior comfort with a refreshing coastal breeze. Culinary enthusiasts will appreciate the minimalist European cabinetry and sleek stainless steel appliances. Step out your front door to immediately immerse yourself in vibrant local boutiques, energetic coffee shops, and top tier dining. You are just moments away from the harbor, Alamitos Beach, the Aquarium of the Pacific, and the Queen Mary, making this the perfect blend of dynamic city living and peaceful relaxation.

results.remarks:
Just steps away from your toes in the sand and the wind in your hair, this stunning beachfront condo offers the perfect blend of coastal living and everyday comfort. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, the open-concept floor plan is designed to maximize both space and the incredible ocean views.
The inviting living room showcases a cozy fireplace and flows seamlessly into the dining area and kitchen, complete with an inviting breakfast bar, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances perfect for casual meals or entertaining. The living room and the master bedroom both have direct access to the oversized private balcony where you can take in breathtaking beach views and enjoy the soothing ocean breeze in your very own privacy.
The spacious primary suite features a thoughtfully designed en-suite bathroom with a closet, dual sinks, a soaking tub, a separate walk-in shower, and a private commode. A walk-through closet conveniently connects the bedroom to the bathroom for added functionality.
Two additional bedrooms are located down the hall along with a full secondary bathroom and a dedicated laundry area with built-in cabinets for extra storage. One of the bedrooms is currently being used as a home office and features custom built-ins, ideal for remote work or a creative space.
Residents enjoy resort-style amenities including a pool, spa, sun deck, sauna, and recreation room bringing vacation living right to your doorstep. Additional highlights include central HVAC, two assigned parking spaces, and guest parking.
Ideally located on the beach and nestled near beloved local hot spots, this exceptional coastal retreat offers the best of relaxed seaside living!

results.remarks: Welcome to 3565 Linden Ave #141, a 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo in Bixby Knolls with 689 square feet of light-filled living space. The kitchen, living room, and primary bedroom share one open flow, so the unit lives larger than its footprint, and natural light reaches nearly every corner. The kitchen comes with a stainless steel refrigerator, an updated stainless steel sink, an electric range, and a dishwasher. In the bathroom, a granite-topped vanity sits alongside a shower/tub combo. Laminate flooring runs throughout, fresh paint covers every wall, and the unit is ready to move into today. A wall unit handles the warm months, and the private patio off the living area is built for actual use, morning coffee, an evening wind-down, or the door propped open for fresh air. The unit comes with one assigned garage parking space, plus nearby street parking, and the building's three elevators make hauling groceries or moving furniture painless. Access to the complex is gated and monitored around the clock. The HOA maintains a genuinely useful lineup of amenities: an in-ground pool, a hot tub, a private barbecue and outdoor cooking area, a picnic space, and a clubhouse with a billiards table. Bixby Knolls is one of Long Beach's tighter-knit neighborhoods, close to Steelcraft's food hall and beer garden and a long stretch of local restaurants and shops, with a Walk Score of 89. Low-maintenance condo, smart investment, or a community that actually feels like one: this Bixby Knolls unit earns a closer look.

Don’t miss the chance to call this trophy property home.

results.remarks:
Your view, your balcony, your walk to everything. This third-floor corner condo at The Tiffany delivers privacy, a peek-a-boo city view, and a location that puts Downtown Long Beach's best right outside your door, all behind the security of a gated community.

Step outside and Shoreline Drive, The Pike Outlets, the Aquarium of the Pacific, and Shoreline Aquatic Park are all within easy walking distance, along with the restaurants and nightlife that make this neighborhood one of the city's most sought-after. Morning coffee by the water, dinner two blocks from home; this is the lifestyle.

Inside, sunlight and coastal breeze move freely through an open layout that leads out to a private balcony, your own spot to unwind, do a little yoga, or sip on your coffee. The kitchen pairs quartz countertops with a smart, functional layout built for both quick meals and entertaining.

The primary suite offers a private ensuite bath, while a beautifully updated guest bathroom serves the rest of the home. Thoughtful upgrades such as new closet doors throughout and ceiling fans in every bedroom add comfort and polish. An in-unit stackable washer and dryer means laundry day never leaves home.

The building itself delivers everyday ease with an elevator and a quiet courtyard retreat.

This is low-maintenance coastal living at its most convenient. Schedule your showing and then pack your bags for your new Long Beach home!

results.remarks:
Welcome to this spacious and beautifully laid-out 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence in the heart of Bixby Knolls—one of Long Beach’s most sought-after neighborhoods. Offering an exceptional combination of size, functionality, and location, this home stands out with a highly desirable and rarely available private 2-car garage, a true rarity for condo living in this area .
Inside, you’ll find an expansive floor plan with generously sized rooms throughout, creating a comfortable and open living environment. Hard surface flooring flows through the main living areas, complemented by a tile kitchen featuring abundant cabinetry, a breakfast bar, and both a formal dining area and separate breakfast nook—ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The oversized living room opens to a large private balcony, perfect for enjoying fresh air, morning coffee, or evening relaxation.
Both bedrooms are well-proportioned, with the spacious primary suite offering its own private bathroom and ample closet space. The thoughtful layout provides privacy between living and sleeping areas while maintaining a natural flow throughout the home.
Located in the vibrant Bixby Knolls district, this home offers outstanding walkability to the popular Atlantic Avenue corridor, known for its boutique shopping, coffee houses, restaurants, and community events. Enjoy close proximity to parks, local schools, and everyday conveniences, along with easy access to major freeways for a seamless commute. The neighborhood’s tree-lined streets, strong community feel, and ongoing revitalization make it one of Long Beach’s most desirable places to live.
Whether you're looking for space, convenience, or lifestyle, this home delivers a rare opportunity to own a well-sized condo with premium features in an unbeatable location.

Welcome to 725 Coronado Ave #206, a two story, townhouse style condo located in the highly desirable Eastside neighborhood of Long Beach. This bright and inviting 2 bedroom/ 1.25 bath corner unit offers about 876 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with the added benefit of no one living above you.
The updated galley kitchen offers generous counter space, wood cabinetry, and a functional layout perfect for everyday living. A convenient 1/4 bath completes the main level.
Upstairs, you’ll find two spacious bedrooms with excellent closet space and a full bathroom featuring a tub. One bedroom opens directly to a private upper-level balcony overlooking the courtyard. The perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind at the end of the day.
Additional highlights include newer vinyl windows, ceiling fans, abundant storage throughout, and a private one car garage providing both secure parking and additional storage.

Unit 311 features an open-concept living and dining area filled with natural light. The living room is anchored by a charming marble fireplace, creating a cozy focal point for everyday living. Balcony shutters add privacy and character, while the seamless flow between the living room, dining area, and kitchen makes the space feel welcoming and functional. Come see Unit 311 and make it yours while it lasts

results.remarks:
Leave the car parked and experience one of Long Beach’s most walkable neighborhoods from this beautifully updated one bedroom condo in the heart of Bluff Park. Just two blocks from the coast and one block from the shops, restaurants and coffee spots along Broadway, this is a location that makes everyday life feel a little more like a vacation. Start the morning with a walk along the bluff, catch a sunset over the ocean, visit the weekly farmers market or head to Belmont Shore and 2nd Street just minutes away. With a 90 Walk Score, some of the best of Long Beach is right outside your front door.
Located inside the Carlton Imperial, a Mid Century building designed by renowned local architect and builder Paul McKenzie, this 753 square foot home offers the spacious layout and abundant natural light his buildings are known for. Inside, the living and dining areas overlook the landscaped courtyard and feature vinyl plank flooring, crown molding, plantation shutters and numerous windows.
The updated kitchen features granite countertops, green glass tile backsplash, white cabinetry, tile flooring, all electric appliances and a new dishwasher. The full bathroom has also been updated with a porcelain vessel sink, granite counter and tile flooring.
The generously sized bedroom offers two separate closet spaces, including a wall length closet with two entrances and an additional space perfect as an office nook, creating an ideal work from home setup or additional storage. Built in hallway cabinetry provides even more room to keep everything organized.
The secure building offers controlled entry, subterranean parking, elevator access and a well maintained interior courtyard. The unit includes one assigned parking space along with additional storage and the building is pet friendly.
Whether you’re looking for your first home, a Long Beach pied à terre or simply a lifestyle where the beach, coffee, dinner and everyday essentials are all within walking distance, 2772 E 2nd St #E2 puts you in the middle of what makes Bluff Park such a special place to live.

This inviting residence offers a bright, open-concept floor plan with abundant natural light, laminate-style flooring, plantation shutters, and a seamless connection between the living and dining areas. The living room is highlighted by a charming marble-accented fireplace and opens to a private balcony surrounded by mature trees—an ideal setting for enjoying fresh air, relaxing, or entertaining.

The dining area features an attractive tray ceiling and flows conveniently into the kitchen, which includes generous cabinetry, tile countertops, a breakfast counter, and major appliances including a refrigerator, gas range, microwave, and dishwasher. A distinctive circular window adds architectural character and additional natural light. Stunning Upgraded 1-Bedroom Condo in Historic Lafayette Building – Steps from the Beach & Downtown Vibes!
Welcome to Unit 356 at the iconic Lafayette, a beautifully preserved 1928 Art Deco gem in the heart of Downtown Long Beach's East Village. This charming 629 sq. ft. one-bedroom, one-bath condo perfectly blends timeless 1920s character with modern upgrades you'll love.
Step inside and be wowed by the fully upgraded kitchen — featuring sleek finishes, contemporary cabinetry, and everything you need to entertain or whip up daily meals with ease. Natural light floods the open living space, highlighting the high ceilings and classic architectural details that make this historic building so special.
Location is everything here: You're just a short stroll from the sand and surf of Long Beach's beautiful waterfront, with easy access to Shoreline Village, the Pike, bustling restaurants, shops, and nightlife. Whether you're commuting via the Metro A Line, hitting the beach for a sunset walk, or exploring the vibrant downtown scene, everything is right at your doorstep in this walker's paradise.
Residents of the Lafayette enjoy premium building amenities, including a fitness center, billiard room, solarium, outdoor BBQ area, and community lounges — all while living in one of Downtown Long Beach's most sought-after historic landmarks.

results.remarks: Discover the ultimate expression of coastal luxury and vibrant downtown living, where modern design meets the heartbeat of the city. This ultra modern space is far more than a home, it is a lifestyle destination. With an impressive 1,050 sq ft of bold open concept living, this is the largest one bedroom layout in the building and a rare opportunity to live expansively in one of Long Beach’s most desirable urban communities. Vaulted ceilings enhance the airy atmosphere while natural light illuminates every corner. The massive living and dining area with a nook offers flexibility to design the perfect entertainment space, home office, or relaxation zone. Rich hardwood and designer tile flooring add warmth and style, while the quartz gourmet kitchen features stainless steel appliances including a brand new dishwasher. Additional conveniences include AC,  in-unit laundry, a modern tankless water heater, and a large hallway storage closet. The spacious bedroom offers excellent storage with double closets. Enjoy Promenade facing views from your private balcony, where you can start your morning with sunshine and unwind in the evening as city lights shimmer. Two gated underground parking spaces plus a significant deeded storage cage provide convenience rarely found in urban living. Located in the exclusive beautifully maintained building, the amenities include guest parking, EV charging, a bike room, a stylish club lounge with a kitchen, television, pool table and shuffleboard, a gym with a yoga studio, and an outdoor courtyard with lounge seating and a cozy firepit. High speed internet, water, trash, and sewage are included in the HOA, providing comfort and ease for homeowners. The location is unbeatable, with the beach, boardwalk, marina, Pike Outlets, Shoreline Village, restaurants, cafes, shopping, nightlife, parks, entertainment, and the Metro line all just moments from your front door. Annual Grand Prix excitement and ongoing waterfront development keep this community vibrant and energetic. Looking toward the future, the 2028 Olympics will bring global attention and major international events to Long Beach including beach volleyball, coastal rowing, sailing, target shooting, sport climbing, handball, canoe sprint, and rowing. Live at the center of world class culture, sports, and coastal excitement. Luxury, location, and lifestyle come together where the ocean meets the city and your future feels inspired.

results.remarks: Welcome Home to this fantastic 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom condo in the highly coveted Blu building in the beautiful East Village area of Long Beach!
